name: LME aluminium price types and 15M/27M forwards, LSEG Datastream, delivered 2026-10-27

source.name: LSEG Datastream (Workspace Chart Studio copies)
source.notes: LME data from LSEG Datastream, copied from Workspace Chart Studio by a project member (TUM chair licence) and handed over unchanged with per-series CSVs.

access.basis: LSEG Workspace via TUM chair: academic use only, project group only; do not publish or pass on the raw data (licence note in the delivery README)
access.retention: Private storage only; never in git; no export until onward use is confirmed in writing

instruments.name: LME aluminium cash
instruments.description: Datastream LAHCASH (RIC MAL0), USD/t. closing = Datastream datatype P "Price - Trade"; for LAH3MTH it equals the LME evening evaluation on 21-22 Oct 2026 (licence holder's check), the same datatype is read as closing here. official bid = LAHCASH(OB). Datastream has no official seller series for cash, so the LME cash settlement price (official seller) is not in this delivery.

instruments.name: LME aluminium 3-month
instruments.description: Datastream LAH3MTH (RIC MAL3), USD/t. closing = Datastream datatype P "Price - Trade"; for LAH3MTH it equals the LME evening evaluation on 21-22 Oct 2026 (licence holder's check), the same datatype is read as closing here. official bid and ask = LAH3MTH(OB) and LAH3MTH(OO).

instruments.name: LME aluminium 15-month
instruments.description: Datastream LAH15MT, USD/t. closing = Datastream datatype P "Price - Trade"; for LAH3MTH it equals the LME evening evaluation on 21-22 Oct 2026 (licence holder's check), the same datatype is read as closing here.

instruments.name: LME aluminium 27-month
instruments.description: Datastream LAH27MT, USD/t. closing = Datastream datatype P "Price - Trade"; for LAH3MTH it equals the LME evening evaluation on 21-22 Oct 2026 (licence holder's check), the same datatype is read as closing here.

note: The three raw tables repeat one truncated column name; positions were matched, value for value on every date, to the per-series CSVs of the delivery (2026-10-27). Times are the archive's file times, read as CET like the delivery's other files.
